note: Automated Crop is an API + one image effect; it has no settings form, configure route, permission, config schema, or Drush. Its config lives on image styles: the image effect plugin id 'automated_crop' (AutomatedCropEffect) stores data.crop_type (a crop module crop_type id) and data.automatic_crop_provider (an AutomatedCrop plugin id, default automated_crop_default). It defines the AutomatedCrop plugin type (manager plugin.manager.automated_crop, dir Plugin/AutomatedCrop, annotation @AutomatedCrop, interface AutomatedCropInterface, base AbstractAutomatedCrop, fallback automated_crop_default) and integrates with the crop module via AUTOMATIC_CROP / AUTOMATIC_CROP_PROVIDERS event subscribers. Requires the crop module (crop types focal_point and freeform exist on this site). Medium/hard cases build/read real image.style.* effect config: introspection reads a style's crop_type/provider; execution adds the automated_crop effect to a style and builds a new style with it, verified against the live ImageStyle effects.

evals.prompt: How do I use the Drupal automated_crop module to automatically crop images through an image style? Name the image effect it provides and the two configuration values that effect needs.
evals.expected_output: Add the 'Automated Crop' image effect (plugin id automated_crop) to an image style. Its config is crop_type (a crop module crop type providing the aspect ratio/limits) and automatic_crop_provider (which AutomatedCrop plugin computes the crop; default automated_crop_default).

evals.prompt: The automated_crop module defines a plugin type for cropping strategies. What is the manager service, the base class to extend, and the id of the default/fallback plugin?
evals.expected_output: Manager service plugin.manager.automated_crop; implement an @AutomatedCrop plugin in Plugin/AutomatedCrop by extending Drupal\automated_crop\AbstractAutomatedCrop (interface AutomatedCropInterface). The default and fallback plugin id is automated_crop_default (a centred crop sized from the aspect ratio).

evals.prompt: Does the automated_crop module have its own admin settings page, and what other contrib module does it depend on to store crops?
evals.expected_output: It has no settings/configure page (configure=null); configuration lives on the image style's Automated Crop effect and on Crop Type entities. It requires the contrib 'crop' module (plus core image/user), and saves crop entities via the crop module's AUTOMATIC_CROP event.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an image style named ac_known that uses the automated_crop module's Automated Crop effect. Inspect the live image style configuration and report which crop type that effect is configured to use.
evals.expected_output: The ac_known image style's automated_crop effect has data.crop_type = freeform.

evals.prompt: The image style ac_known on this site has an Automated Crop effect. Inspect its live configuration and report which automatic crop provider (AutomatedCrop plugin) it is set to use.
evals.expected_output: The ac_known automated_crop effect has data.automatic_crop_provider = automated_crop_default (the default centred-crop provider).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an image style with machine name ac_task that currently has no effects. Using the automated_crop module, add its Automated Crop image effect to this style, configured with a valid crop type (e.g. focal_point or freeform). Apply the change to the live image style.
evals.expected_output: The ac_task image style has an effect with id 'automated_crop' whose data.crop_type is a real crop type (e.g. $style->addImageEffect(['id'=>'automated_crop','data'=>['crop_type'=>'focal_point','automatic_crop_provider'=>'automated_crop_default']]); $style->save()).

evals.prompt: Create a new image style with machine name ac_build on this Drupal site, and give it an Automated Crop effect (from the automated_crop module) that crops using the 'freeform' crop type. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An image style ac_build exists with an 'automated_crop' effect whose data.crop_type is 'freeform' (create the style, add the Automated Crop effect with crop type freeform, and save).
